measurement_caveats: Capture-to-encode only: no transport, audio, AMD client, physical display or panel luminance measurement.
The photographic source is 25 fps; capture counts are not unique application frames.
queue_us begins when capture delivers the frame, not when scene rendering starts; convert_us includes GPU preparation/send_frame, and packet drain timing is not total hardware encoding latency.
The test requests one recovery IDR near its end and retains only that suffix for post-measurement software decoding. Production infinite-GOP behavior is unchanged.
An earlier diagnostic falsely grew RSS by retaining the entire infinite GOP; bounded retention fixed the test, not production code.
An initial post-seek comparison correctly failed because the frame had not settled; the recorded Vulkan comparison verifies identical raw captures before and after encoding.
SDR PNG previews are tone-mapped comparison aids, not proof of HDR panel output.
Results establish minute-scale stability, not an hours-long soak test or device migration across GPUs.
